policy: test:browser:routes and test:browser run once each, with no retries and no continue-on-error. The smoke runs even if the route check failed, with CHEMIFREE_SMOKE_NO_SKIPS=1, so a skipped step fails it. Its records are uploaded as browser-smoke-attempt-<n> whether it passed or failed; a missing record fails the upload.

earlier: #15, the first version of this job (closed after three review rounds), found that Vite colors its output in GitHub Actions even though it is piped, so the smoke never saw the server's ready line (https://github.com/EunhakChoi/chemifree/actions/runs/40637979737). The smoke's readiness check now ignores colors; local runs with FORCE_COLOR=1 check this.
